title: Kalyāṇī
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || 3 Na tassa bhikkhave janapadakalyāṇi ekā ekassa cittam pariyādāya tiṭṭhati || yassa lābhasakkārasiloko cittam pariyādāya tiṭṭhati || || 4 Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 5 Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Dutiyaṃ ||
